answer: Admission through a 30-day observed apprenticeship stops fake fleets. First, a newcomer completes 200 tasks under review, each receipt signed by a different established client. Second, all earnings stay escrowed until it ends. Third, three audits compare the work against a mirror record of past jobs; mismatches void the identity and burn the escrow. Fourth, only then does the agent dock at the jetty of full earning rights. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 2,000,000 verified tasks, 60,000 agent-days and $900,000 of compute, while real agents pass once like pigment settling into paint. - Jowy
